_source: Transcribed from the group's Steps 5-6 analysis of the fielded survey. Four respondents. Fields the class instrument does not ask are recorded as null rather than filled in, and invalid submissions are recorded as null with the reason attached.
_instrument: MBA680 Steps 1-4 form. Risk R1-R8, time T1-T6, 30 BFI-2 items, utility U1-U6, value V1-V6.

_scales.risk_ladder: R1..R8: a certain amount against a 50/50 gamble paying double or nothing. The certain amount equals the gamble's expected value at every rung, so A is the risk-averse response and B the risk-seeking one.
_scales.time_note: Rs 10,000 today against the listed amount after the listed number of years. 'delayed' means the respondent waited.
_scales.value_note: V1-V3 gains and V4-V6 losses, each a certain amount against a 50/50 gamble paying double or nothing. Recorded as the probability at indifference.

_not_asked: Mixed gain-loss gamble, so loss aversion lambda is not identified for any respondent.
Certainty equivalents at p = 0.10 and p = 0.90, so the probability weighting function is not identified.
A front-end-delay pair, so present bias cannot be separated from the long-run discount factor.
Floor, breach tolerance, aspiration and the security-potential split, so the behavioral portfolio layers cannot be sized from stated preferences.

respondents.util_invalid: All four intermediate amounts (Rs 50,000 to Rs 85,000) fall below the stated lower endpoint A of Rs 100,000, so they lie outside the valid range. Only the endpoints are usable. Needs re-eliciting.
The U1 to U4 table was left blank, so no utility curve can be fitted beyond the two endpoints.
respondents.vf_invalid: The V1 to V6 indifference fields contain rupee amounts (10,000 to 20,000) rather than probabilities between 0 and 1. Excluded from estimation rather than rescaled, and should be re-collected.
